# DD1 — upstream deepdenoiser ships no dependency lockfile

**Section**: A. Build pipeline & dependencies
**Keywords**: build, bun, bun.lockb, convention, copied, deepdenoiser, dependencies, dependency, deps, expo, frozen-lockfile, gitignored, install, lockfile, mirror, overrides, pipeline, reproducibility, ships, upstream

## Problem

upstream deepdenoiser ships no dependency lockfile

## Root cause

bun.lockb/bun.lock gitignored upstream (expo/rn convention)

## Solution

pin deps in overrides/bun.lock copied into the CI mirror before bun install --frozen-lockfile
